placements.title: Structuring engineering retrospectives to foster continuous team reflection and process refinement
placements.frame: How should engineering teams structure sprint retrospectives to capture actionable feedback and evolve team operating practices?
placements.why: The source content establishes a team-wide shift in retrospective ceremony structure (adopting the Velociraptor format to replace start-stop-continue), minting a standalone narrative theme for agile team rituals and continuous reflection.
